title: 2023 Panini Select #CRO-NTD Tank Dell Houston Texans Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2023 Panini Select Sports Trading Card features Tank Dell, a rookie player from the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the Select Certified Rookies insert set and has a card number of CRO-NTD. It is perfect for collectors who are fans of football and want to add a valuable item to their collection. The card is manufactured by Panini and is a single trading card.
